title: Dolina Charlotty — social media for a lakeside resort & spa that turns reach into real visits
excerpt: End-to-end social media for Dolina Charlotty Resort & Spa on Facebook and Instagram — 15.5M views and +168.8% interactions on Facebook, plus +1706% content views on Instagram.
clientAbout: Dolina Charlotty Resort & Spa is a scenic leisure complex set between Słupsk and Ustka. Spread across 120 hectares are a hotel, restaurants, a spa & wellness area, and a long list of attractions for adults and kids alike — from treehouses and the exotic Bali Hai spa to a zoo and the Charlotta seal sanctuary. It is a place that brings comfort, nature, and culture together, offering a break surrounded by forest and lake.

Dolina Charlotty is also known for its standout events — its 10,000-seat amphitheater hosts Festiwal Legend Rocka (the Rock Legends Festival), which draws music stars from around the world. Between the relaxation, the entertainment, and the exotic feel of the Bali Indah complex, it has become one of the most recognizable tourist destinations in Poland.

challenge.intro: Social Lama's brief was to grow interest in what Dolina Charlotty offers and get audiences to actually come and visit — so that the image built online would translate into guests on site.
objectives: Building a consistent, authentic brand identity for Dolina Charlotty.
Creating an emotional, engaging narrative across online communication.
Drawing audiences into active dialogue and interaction with the brand.
Increasing visits and real interest in what the resort has to offer.

pillars.heading: Raising awareness of what makes Dolina unique
body: Our goal here was to make Dolina Charlotty better known as a one-of-a-kind place where nature, culture, and luxury meet. The content we published on social media showed the resort's full range — from treehouses and the Bali Hai spa to the amphitheater that hosts world-famous artists.
Reels, posts, and stories presented Dolina as a space of emotion and experience, inspiring people to visit and to keep discovering its attractions year-round.

pillars.heading: Building an authentic, emotional bond with the audience
body: We built the communication on a warm, friendly, engaging narrative that shows Dolina through people's eyes — guests, staff, and performers. Content grounded in storytelling, natural shots, and emotion strengthened the sense of authenticity and closeness to the brand.
Pairing a strong aesthetic with real stories and glimpses of everyday life at the resort gave the communication a more human, inspiring dimension.

pillars.heading: Growing audience trust and building a credible image
body: One of the key goals was to get audiences interacting with the brand and taking an active part in life at Dolina Charlotty. We introduced quizzes, polls, and questions in stories, built around memories of a stay and the urge to come back to Dolina.
We talked to users in a natural, direct way, which let us build an engaged community around shared values — nature, relaxation, and good energy.

pillars.heading: More visits and real interest in what the resort offers
body: The point of this work was to turn the online image into real visits to Dolina Charlotty. We promoted seasonal offers — winter break, family vacations, Valentine's Day, and Festiwal Legend Rocka — as eye-catching visual content.
Consistent communication and authentic content made Dolina a place people don't just follow: they want to visit it in person, experience it, and remember it.

pillars.heading: Dedicated video and photo shoots on site
body: Shooting dedicated video on site let us capture the authenticity of Dolina Charlotty and its everyday magic. The team visited the key locations in person, creating material that captures the charm of the place through the eyes of potential guests — from families with kids to people coming for events like the winter break.

Our own photo shoots filled out that picture, presenting the accommodation, family attractions, and events in a consistent, polished way. As a result, the video and photos used in campaigns didn't just catch attention — they built an emotional connection and encouraged people to experience Dolina's atmosphere for themselves.
